participantDetailPresentation.sufficiencyDetail: compact bottom sheet over the main result scene
participantDetailPresentation.attentionDetailHierarchy: primary focus -> self-explanation -> secondary 3/3 background evidence

routeEndpointRendering.oneEndpoint: one route-relevant land; duplicate large endpoint summary above the land is hidden
routeEndpointRendering.multipleEndpoints: all valid route-relevant lands/endpoints are rendered; do not silently truncate protocol-valid B+ similar results
routeEndpointRendering.noRoute: no inactive lands; compact no-route state

resultWorld.sufficiencyProvenanceHeadingLt: Kaip ši pakankamumo sritis buvo išskirta?
resultWorld.finalShipGraphicForm: minimalist inline SVG sailboat; solid neutral line grammar; no dashed prototype geometry

resultWorld.mapRevisionReason: Owner judged the prior live adaptation only minimally different from the cloud/blob version. Revision therefore changed coastline geometry substantially rather than making incremental styling tweaks.
resultWorld.mapTargetReference: owner-approved generated target derived from the supplied fantasy-map reference, adapted as neutral PrioLens page graphics rather than used as a static image
resultWorld.mapTerrainCues: generic and decorative only: subtle mountains, river, lake, grove, islets; no semantic mapping to need types
resultWorld.mapLocationMarker: neutral ring-and-dot pin; no deficit/red encoding
resultWorld.mapLabelPresentation: need label is direct map annotation with subtle text halo; no white result-chip block
resultWorld.shipBackdrop: subtle distant-land horizon + pale water cues; no semantic encoding
resultWorld.mapCoastGrammar: mixed straight/angled segments plus limited curves; explicit bays, peninsulas and concavities; avoid repeated rounded scallops

bridgePrimaryRepresentations.CONTROL: 5x10; related B areas 5,9,10; action-effect agency, not autonomy

researchParallels.purpose: optional interpretive parallels for read-in participants, not validation of PrioLens constructs
researchParallels.attentionBoundary: attention can reflect physical salience, current goals and learned value; A is not interpreted as an unmet need
researchParallels.sufficiencyBoundary: scarcity/need-frustration evidence is domain-specific and is not generalized to all 12 PrioLens B areas

humanInterpretation.mode: deterministic auditable composer; no LLM at runtime
humanInterpretation.boundaryLt: Tai bendrinė refleksija pagal šios sesijos pasirinkimus. Ne diagnozė ir ne išvada apie tavo asmenybę.
inputs: B/B+ insufficiency route as narrative anchor
all raw MOST 3/3 and 2/3 repeated A directions
exact 3/3 LEAST only as cautious secondary contrast
rules: never infer subconscious, true need or personality
use specific semantic bridges only when construct map supports a plausible relation
if no defensible bridge exists, state that the perspectives need not be forced into one story
